name: Assets
purpose: Verify format, decoding, dimensions, canvas fit, provenance, rights and technical delivery properties.

baseline_claims.need: The claimed format decodes in its reference validator or runtime.
Dimensions, alpha, colour, layers and canvas constraints match the target.
Source, author, rights, transforms and digest are traceable.
Size, memory and performance budgets fit the named target profile.
Taste or visual quality remains a steward judgement, not one optimized score.
Derived exports stay bound to their editable source and validation receipt.
